description: This file defines a dependency injection component that creates and returns a ResourceServer object, configured with OAuth2 access token repository and public key, wrapped in middleware. It leverages external OAuth2 library classes and references internal SuiteCRM OAuth2 repository classes.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\API\OAuth2\Keys
classes.description: Class providing OAuth2 key management, specifically returning the public key used by ResourceServer.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\API\OAuth2\Repositories\AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class for OAuth2 access tokens, used by the ResourceServer for token validation.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\API\OAuth2\Middleware\ResourceServer
classes.description: Middleware class wrapping the OAuth2 ResourceServer to handle access control.

methods.name: return $container['ResourceServer']
methods.description: Immutable closure defining how to instantiate and return the ResourceServer middleware with dependencies injected.
